title: Time Jump: 11:00 — System Isolated, Public Trust Eroding

fields.narration: It is now 11:00. The control system remains isolated. The HMI on MBW-HMI-02 continues to display NAOH-FC-203 at 14 mg/L, but lab results from three consecutive grab samples collected at 10:30, 10:45, and 11:00 confirm finished-water pH at 9.6 and caustic dose at 38 mg/L. The SCADA / IT Security Manager has not detected any new remote sessions. The Ohio EPA DDAGW has not rescinded the Level 3 — Public Health Emergency. The public is still demanding answers. The manual operations protocol remains active. No return to automatic control is authorized.
worldState: The control system remains isolated from the business LAN and the SCADA network.
Lab results from 11:00 confirm pH 9.6 and caustic dose 38 mg/L — both above safe limits.
No new remote sessions have been detected on MBW-HMI-02 since 10:50.
The Do Not Drink advisory for Zone 1 remains active.
The SCADA / IT Security Manager has not yet restored the HMI to a trusted state.
The Water Quality Manager has not yet verified the final clean sample from the Clearwell 1 outlet.
The public has not received confirmation that the system is under control.

instructorNote: This time jump confirms the system remains in manual mode and trust in the control system has not been restored. The ICS team must now validate the final verification steps before any return to service.
